title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5: Security and Privacy Controls for IoT and Information Systems

controls.name: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.guidance: Implement boundary protection, ingress rate-limiting, SYN cookies, and adaptive traffic throttling at the IoT network gateway to restrict volumetric flood attacks and maintain availability of critical services.

controls.name: Boundary Protection & Dynamic ARP Inspection
controls.guidance: Enforce managed network interfaces, DHCP snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI), and 802.1X port security to prevent adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) ARP spoofing and IP header forgery.

controls.name: Information System Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
controls.guidance: Continuously monitor inbound and outbound network telemetry for anomalous protocol usage, abnormal inter-arrival time (IAT), header length fluctuations, and unexpected connection state flags.

controls.name: Incident Handling & Response Procedures
controls.guidance: Formulate prioritized playbooks for volumetric DDoS, single-endpoint DoS, and spoofing intrusions with step-by-step forensic logging, containment isolation, and post-incident verification.
